attempt: Treat compressed NumPy NpzFile subscripts as cached arrays inside per-tree and per-cell placement loops.
reason_failed: Repeated A[key] accesses re-read and decompress the same full terrain grids. The local planner made slow progress; a diagnostic stack showed zipfile reads through numpy NpzFile.__getitem__ from the candidate loop.

environment.runtime: Windows, Python and NumPy, compressed NPZ terrain grids

error_signature: Slow planning loop; diagnostic stack in zipfile read -> numpy read_array -> NpzFile.__getitem__.
conditions: Compressed NPZ accessed from a hot loop
Same large grid selected repeatedly by key
workaround: Materialize only the required arrays once before the hot loop, or store arrays in local variables. Reuse them for placements and verification; distinguish the archive object from the array data.

source_refs.description: Observed diagnostic stack and local workaround, without benchmark claims.
Planner materializes the analysis archive before all placement loops.
Final output installed after native and preservation checks.
